cond_0001.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples and leveraging our expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0001.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Master of Science degree with nine years' research experience
Terminal Degree with six years' post-doctoral experience
Preferred Requirements
Strong publication track record in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology

cond_0008.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples, leveraging expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology — demonstrated by a strong publication track record — are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0008.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Oversee a team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2, ensuring scientific activities stay on track. Drive clear, professional communication to achieve mutual understanding and resolve issues. Lead a team-focused work environment where members actively help one another reach scientific goals. Champion collaboration among all members of the research team by proactively communicating and reporting pertinent information related to assigned systems. Respond decisively to requests for assistance and hold peers accountable toward improvement of department engagement scores. Teach peers and staff to think critically by articulating the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, own the workflow, proactively solve problems, anticipate needs, and manage multiple ongoing priorities. Independently resolve complex problems and issues, and report outcomes to PI/Faculty. Serve as escalation support for less experienced staff. Execute data analysis for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintain accurate records of all research and data collection. Carry out research and incorporate novel procedures and methods into experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, write and maintain regulatory and safety committee applications and protocols. Apply advanced technical research skills and establish test methods and procedures. Document procedures and changes in the PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establish and maintain quality control of project operations, including setting appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Use resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manage time effectively and prioritize work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Ensure orders for supplies are charged to appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contribute to publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determine specific research project goals and objectives. Take ownership of and accountability for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Develop the skills of lab team members (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participate in conferences and seminars. Proactively manage own professional development and complete My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Preferred Requirements
Strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, or nanomedicine
Strong publication track record

Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory at [Company name masked] currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples, leveraging expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology — demonstrated by a strong publication track record — are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our curiosity and sense of urgency around research.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0015.responsibilities:
People
Actively supports the PI/faculty by staying in regular contact with a team of Research Assistants and Post Docs (0–2 scientific staff). Communicates needs, issues, and important information to keep the science on track. Initiates open, professional conversations to reach mutual understanding and resolve problems. Models clear communication skills and brings people together to work through issues. Contributes to a team-focused environment where members actively help one another meet scientific goals. Promotes a positive working relationship with the interprofessional care team. Keeps all research team members connected by regularly sharing pertinent information related to assigned systems. Responds positively to requests for assistance and participates actively in teamwork. Teaches peers and staff to think critically by verbally explaining the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently. Engages in peer-to-peer accountability to support improvement in employee engagement.
Service
At the PI/Faculty's direction, organizes workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes and performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.

Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. cond_0044.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples, leveraging expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology — demonstrated by a strong publication track record — are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0044.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Oversee a team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2, ensuring scientific activities stay on track. Drive clear, professional communication to achieve mutual understanding and resolve issues. Lead a team-focused work environment where members actively help one another reach scientific goals. Champion collaboration among all members of the research team by proactively communicating and reporting pertinent information related to assigned systems. Respond decisively to requests for assistance and hold peers accountable toward improvement of department engagement scores. Teach peers and staff to think critically by articulating the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, own the workflow, proactively solve problems, anticipate needs, and manage multiple ongoing priorities. Independently resolve complex problems and issues, and report outcomes to PI/Faculty. Serve as escalation support for less experienced staff. Execute data analysis for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintain accurate records of all research and data collection. Carry out research and incorporate novel procedures and methods into experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, write and maintain regulatory and safety committee applications and protocols. Apply advanced technical research skills and establish test methods and procedures. Document procedures and changes in the PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establish and maintain quality control of project operations, including setting appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Use resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manage time effectively and prioritize work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Ensure orders for supplies are charged to appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contribute to publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determine specific research project goals and objectives. Take ownership of and accountability for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Develop the skills of lab team members (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participate in conferences and seminars. Proactively manage own professional development and complete My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, or nanomedicine
Strong publication track record

The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology—demonstrated by a strong publication track record—are encouraged to apply.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0079.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Supports the PI/faculty by monitoring the activities of Research Assistants and Post Docs (0–2 staff). Communicates needs, issues, and relevant information to the PI to support scientific progress. Maintains clear, professional communication to reach mutual understanding and resolve problems. Contributes to a team-focused work environment where members support one another in meeting scientific goals. Coordinates with the interprofessional care team to achieve department objectives. Reports pertinent information related to assigned systems to the research team in a thorough and timely manner. Responds to requests for assistance from team members. Guides peers and staff in critical thinking by explaining the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently. Supports peer accountability toward improvement of department engagement scores.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/faculty direction, organizes workflow, anticipates needs, and manages multiple concurrent priorities. Independently resolves complex problems and reports issues and resolutions to the PI/faculty. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Carries out research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At PI/faculty direction, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications and protocols. Applies advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes in the PI/faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations, including appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Uses resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time and prioritizes work to achieve results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring supply orders are charged to appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contributes to publication and grant writing at PI/faculty direction. Identifies specific research project goals and objectives and takes responsibility for those at the PI/faculty's direction. Supports skills development of lab team members (staff and students) in line with scientific objectives. Attends conferences and seminars. Manages own professional development and completes a development plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Terminal degree with six years of post-doctoral experience, or Master of Science degree with nine years of research experience
Strong background in at least one of the following: tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, or nanomedicine
Preferred Requirements
Demonstrated publication track record reflecting research expertise

cond_0118.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples and leveraging our expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0118.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

cond_0133.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples, drawing on expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology—demonstrated by a strong publication track record—are encouraged to apply.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0133.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Supports the PI/faculty by monitoring the activities of Research Assistants and Post Docs (0–2 staff). Communicates needs, issues, and relevant information to the PI to support scientific progress. Maintains clear, professional communication to reach mutual understanding and resolve problems. Contributes to a team-focused work environment where members support one another in meeting scientific goals. Coordinates with the interprofessional care team to achieve department objectives. Reports pertinent information related to assigned systems to the research team in a thorough and timely manner. Responds to requests for assistance from team members. Guides peers and staff in critical thinking by explaining the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently. Supports peer accountability toward improvement of department engagement scores.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/faculty direction, organizes workflow, anticipates needs, and manages multiple concurrent priorities. Independently resolves complex problems and reports issues and resolutions to the PI/faculty. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Carries out research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At PI/faculty direction, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications and protocols. Applies advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes in the PI/faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations, including appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Uses resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time and prioritizes work to achieve results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring supply orders are charged to appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contributes to publication and grant writing at PI/faculty direction. Identifies specific research project goals and objectives and takes responsibility for those at the PI/faculty's direction. Supports skills development of lab team members (staff and students) in line with scientific objectives. Attends conferences and seminars. Manages own professional development and completes a development plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Demonstrated publication track record reflecting research expertise

Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.
cond_0281.requirements: Terminal degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred, with a minimum of six years of demonstrated post-doctoral expertise, or a Master of Science degree with a minimum of nine years of substantial research experience.
cond_0281.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

cond_0282.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples and leveraging our expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org

cond_0296.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples, leveraging expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology — demonstrated by a strong publication track record — are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0296.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Oversee a team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2, ensuring scientific activities stay on track. Drive clear, professional communication to achieve mutual understanding and resolve issues. Lead a team-focused work environment where members actively help one another reach scientific goals. Champion collaboration among all members of the research team by proactively communicating and reporting pertinent information related to assigned systems. Respond decisively to requests for assistance and hold peers accountable toward improvement of department engagement scores. Teach peers and staff to think critically by articulating the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, own the workflow, proactively solve problems, anticipate needs, and manage multiple ongoing priorities. Independently resolve complex problems and issues, and report outcomes to PI/Faculty. Serve as escalation support for less experienced staff. Execute data analysis for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintain accurate records of all research and data collection. Carry out research and incorporate novel procedures and methods into experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, write and maintain regulatory and safety committee applications and protocols. Apply advanced technical research skills and establish test methods and procedures. Document procedures and changes in the PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establish and maintain quality control of project operations, including setting appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Use resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manage time effectively and prioritize work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Ensure orders for supplies are charged to appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contribute to publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determine specific research project goals and objectives. Take ownership of and accountability for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Develop the skills of lab team members (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participate in conferences and seminars. Proactively manage own professional development and complete My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0372.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.
cond_0372.requirements: Around six years of post-doctoral experience with a Terminal Degree, or around nine years of research experience with a Master of Science degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0472.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory at [Company name masked] currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples and leveraging our expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of the underlying biology and experimental approaches involved.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0472.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

cond_0479.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory at [Company name masked] currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples and leveraging our expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0479.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

cond_0493.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples, drawing on expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology—demonstrated by a strong publication track record—are encouraged to apply.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0493.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Supports the PI/faculty by monitoring the activities of Research Assistants and Post Docs (0–2 staff). Communicates needs, issues, and relevant information to the PI to support scientific progress. Maintains clear, professional communication to reach mutual understanding and resolve problems. Contributes to a team-focused work environment where members support one another in meeting scientific goals. Coordinates with the interprofessional care team to achieve department objectives. Reports pertinent information related to assigned systems to the research team in a thorough and timely manner. Responds to requests for assistance from team members. Guides peers and staff in critical thinking by explaining the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently. Supports peer accountability toward improvement of department engagement scores.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/faculty direction, organizes workflow, anticipates needs, and manages multiple concurrent priorities. Independently resolves complex problems and reports issues and resolutions to the PI/faculty. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Carries out research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At PI/faculty direction, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications and protocols. Applies advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes in the PI/faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations, including appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Uses resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time and prioritizes work to achieve results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring supply orders are charged to appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contributes to publication and grant writing at PI/faculty direction. Identifies specific research project goals and objectives and takes responsibility for those at the PI/faculty's direction. Supports skills development of lab team members (staff and students) in line with scientific objectives. Attends conferences and seminars. Manages own professional development and completes a development plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Support the PI/faculty by helping coordinate the activities of Research Assistants and Post Docs (0–2 staff). Share updates on needs and issues to help ensure scientific success. Facilitate open, professional communication to reach mutual understanding and resolve problems. Contribute to a team-focused work environment where members actively help one another achieve scientific goals. Help maintain a positive working relationship with the interprofessional care team to support department results. Keep all members of the research team informed by communicating and reporting relevant information in a comprehensive manner. Respond positively to requests for assistance and support peers. Help peers and staff think critically by sharing the rationale behind decisions and following up consistently. Support peer-to-peer accountability to improve department engagement scores.
Service Essential Functions
At the PI/Faculty's direction, help coordinate workflow, proactively problem-solve, anticipate needs, and manage multiple ongoing priorities. Work through complex problems and issues independently, keeping the PI/Faculty informed of issues and resolutions. Serve as a resource and escalation support for less experienced staff. Collaborate on data analysis for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintain accurate records of all research and data collection. Carry out research and incorporate novel procedures and methods into experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, help write and maintain regulatory and safety committee applications and protocols. Provide advanced technical research skills and help establish test methods and procedures. Document procedures and changes in the PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Help establish and maintain quality control of project operations, including appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Use resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manage time well and prioritize work to achieve results in a timely manner. Help ensure that supply orders are charged to the appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Contribute to publication and grant writing at the PI/Faculty's direction. Work with the PI/Faculty to clarify specific research project goals and objectives, and share responsibility for meeting them. Help develop the skills of lab team members (staff and students) in line with scientific objectives. Participate in conferences and seminars. Proactively manage your own professional development and complete your Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

cond_0541.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples and leveraging our expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org

cond_0587.intro:
Dr. Kyuson Yun's laboratory at [Company name masked] currently focuses on cancer stem cells and tumor immunology using genetically engineered mouse models, patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and fresh patient samples and leveraging our expertise in single-cell genomics. The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency.
Please submit a cover letter and CV to kyun@houstonmethodist.org
cond_0587.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

The long-term goal of the lab is to develop novel cancer therapies through foundational discoveries and technology development.
Ongoing projects include: 1) elucidating novel mechanisms of immune suppression, particularly in a sex-biased manner, 2) discovering novel immunotherapy targets through single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of human cancers, 3) developing new biologic and nanotherapies to target cancer stem cells and immune suppression in brain cancer and other solid tumors.
Candidates with a strong background in tumor immunology, computational biology, stem cell biology, pharmacology, molecular biology/biochemistry, nanomedicine, or pharmacology- demonstrated by a strong publication track record- are strongly encouraged to apply. We seek team members who share our passion for research, mission, and sense of curiosity and urgency. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the underlying logic of cancer biology and immunology research.
cond_0643.responsibilities:
People Essential Functions
Assists PI/faculty by monitoring team of Research Assistants and Post Docs 0-2 scientific activities. Provides communication of needs, issues to be addressed, and all important information necessary to ensure scientific success. Facilitates open, professional, communication to achieve mutual understanding. Role models excellent, clear, and professional communication skills to achieve mutual understanding and problem resolution. Contributes to a team-focused work environment that actively helps one another achieve scientific goals. Promotes a positive work environment with the interprofessional care team to achieve optimal department results. Ensures collaboration among all members of the research team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent information as it relates to assigned system(s) in a comprehensive manner. Participates in teamwork by responding positively to requests for assistance. Teaches peers and staff to critically think by verbally expressing rationale for decisions and follows up consistently. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards improvement of department score for employee engagement.
Service Essential Functions
At PI/Faculty's direction, organizes the workflow, proactively problem solves, anticipates needs, and manages multiple ongoing priorities. Independently handles resolution of complex problems and issues and notifies PI/Faculty of issue and resolution. Serves as escalation support for less experienced staff. Analyzes data for research grants and publications (medium to high complexity). Maintains accurate records of all research and data collection. Completes/performs research and incorporates novel procedures and methods into research experiments as appropriate (medium complexity).
Quality/Safety Essential Functions
At the direction of the PI/Faculty, writes and maintains regulatory and safety committee applications/protocols. Provides advanced technical research skills and establishes test methods and procedures. Documents procedures and changes to procedure in PI/Faculty's Lab Study Methods manual and Laboratory Notebooks. Establishes and maintains quality control of project operations including establishing appropriate controls and standards for experimental procedures.
Finance Essential Functions
Utilizes resources effectively and efficiently, demonstrating responsible financial stewardship. Manages own time effectively and prioritizes work to achieve maximum results in a timely manner. Assists with ensuring orders for supplies are on appropriate grants.
Growth/Innovation Essential Functions
Participates in publication and grant writing at PI/Faculty direction. Determines specific research project goals and objectives to be attained. Assumes responsibility and oversight for those goals and objectives at the PI/Faculty's direction. Assists with developing skills of lab team (staff and students) in alignment with scientific objectives. Participates in conferences and seminars. Proactively manages own professional development and completes My Development Plan.
This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; the employee will also perform other reasonably related business/job duties as assigned. [Company name masked] reserves the right to revise job duties and responsibilities as the need arises.

Terminal Degree with Six years' post-doctoral experience or Master of Science degree with nine years' research experience
